Chakala Cha Vigneshwar
Chakala Sarvajanik Ganesh Utsav Mandal, popularly known as Chakala Cha Vigneshwar, is a public Ganeshotsav mandal (festival committee) based in the Chakala area of Andheri East, Mumbai, India. Established in 2018 by five teenagers, it has since grown into one of the most vibrant youth-led Ganesh celebrations in the locality. The mandal is notable for its creative themes, elaborate decorations, and strong emphasis on community participation.
History
The Chakala Sarvajanik Ganesh Utsav Mandal was founded in 2018 by five teenagers from Andheri East. Unlike many other mandals in Mumbai, it is entirely youth-led and funded through personal savings and contributions from its members. Over the years, the mandal has expanded its scale, attracting large crowds from across Chakala and neighboring areas.
Celebrations
The mandal organizes annual Ganeshotsav festivities that blend traditional Maharashtrian rituals with modern artistic expression. Highlights include:
- Ganpati installations: The idols are crafted with intricate artistry, often depicting mythological themes. Past themes have included deep-sea mythology tied to Lord Krishna.
- Decorations: Known for elaborate stage designs and lighting, the mandal emphasizes creativity and cultural storytelling.
- Processions: The aagaman (arrival) and visarjan (immersion) processions are celebrated with music, dance, and community participation.
- Digital presence: The mandal actively shares reels and updates on Instagram, engaging younger audiences and expanding its reach online.
Notable Artists
In recent years, the mandal has collaborated with renowned murtikar (idol maker) Ratnesh Lotlikar, whose craftsmanship has been central to the grandeur of the celebrations in 2025–2026.
Community Impact
Chakala Cha Vigneshwar has become a cultural hub for youth in Andheri East. Its emphasis on self-funding and volunteerism distinguishes it from larger, commercially sponsored mandals. The initiative has inspired other local youth groups to take leadership in organizing community festivals.
Location
The mandal is located in Chakala, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Its central location makes it accessible to residents and visitors across the city.
